title: Dunesider Dream | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front + Gulf Views in WaterSound- Dunesider Dream by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Dunesider Dream by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Beach Address: 37 Compass Point Way, #108, WaterSound, FL 32461 Details: WaterSound truly lives up to its name- nestled along the breathtaking beaches of the Emerald Coast, it’s a coastal paradise for the senses. Dunesider Dream is a beautifully designed 3-bedroom plus bunk, 3.5-bath gulf-front condo featuring elegant, professionally curated décor. With spacious interiors and plenty of room to unwind, this retreat also offers generous outdoor living areas with a screened-in porch and a private balcony perfect for soaking in the salt air and the soothing sound of the waves. This sought-after WaterSound residence provides the best of both worlds: a peaceful, private escape that’s still close to all the excitement and charm of 30A. Just 70 feet away, the inviting pool area offers ample chaise lounges with umbrellas, where you can relax under the sun or enjoy a seasonal poolside lunch or snack. A picturesque wooden bridge winds over the sugar-white dunes, leading directly to the pristine beaches of the Emerald Coast: your own gateway to paradise. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 75 Yards -LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Included -Parking Spaces: 2 (1 in Driveway and Additional in Front of Building) -Dining Accommodations: Table for 8 and Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Located in the WaterSound Community -A short walk to the Dunesider Community Pool WaterSound Community Highlights: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to The Big Chill *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 3 Bedrooms Plus a Bunk Alcove / 3.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bunk Alcove: (Twin/Twin) -Laundry Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room / Balcony with Seating Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
